kinds.d: Program that copies files, a disk or a whole system image to the owner's own drives; backup to a provider's servers is in Subscriptions, Memberships & Online Services.
Program that recovers deleted, lost or corrupted files from drives, memory cards and damaged partitions.
Program that moves installed applications, settings and files from one computer to another.

notes: Restraint-only. Backup software 74->15: kept built-in OS tools, consumer market brands and the main free/open-source tools; dropped enterprise and server products (Commvault, Cohesity, Rubrik, Veritas Backup Exec, IBM Spectrum Protect, EMC NetWorker, HP Data Protector, NetVault, Bacula, Amanda, Proxmox Backup Server, DPM etc.), raw command-line tools (dd, dcfldd, partimage, ntfsclone), discontinued tails (NTBackup, Norton Ghost, FlyBack, SyncToy, X-Copy) and misfiled partition tools (AOMEI Partition Assistant, DiskGenius, GParted Live CD, Disk Utility); old Norton range dropped. Image, file, sync and cloning are types. Data recovery 16->10. PC migration 18->6: dropped User State Migration Tool (enterprise), Zinstall business editions (WinServ, Migration Suite), PCmover side products and obscure tools; Windows Easy Transfer kept as the icon of the kind. No new kinds.
